subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A uniform is usually meant to make students look the same.”?
options: Fields, greenhouses, rooftops, and warehouses may all become part of feeding cities.
Maggie's old uniform had become different because it carried her own memories.
Old crops can carry traits that become valuable again under new conditions.
But after many years, it can become a record of ordinary days.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A uniform is usually meant to make students look the same. Maggie's old uniform had become different because it carried her own memories.」，答案為「Maggie's old uniform had become different because it carried her own memories.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Maggie's old uniform had become different because it carried her own memories.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
